title: Chapter 125 Ao Qing Is So Terrifying
content:
Chapter 125 Ao Qing Is So Terrifying

Han Tianren continued, "I did not break through to the super god realm."

"But I found a senior who can help Tianlin Star Region get out of trouble."

A senior who got out of trouble?

Everyone looked puzzled.

But the next moment, a sword sound that shook the world rang out from the depths of Tianlin Star Region.

Everyone present was shocked when they sensed the terrifying sword intent.

What a strong sword intent.

Could it be a sword god? !

If that's true, it would be too terrifying.

In the distance, Wang Zhen also looked a little gloomy. He hadn't felt the level of this sword intent yet.

But as long as he sensed that this sword intent reached the realm of godhood, he would immediately order a retreat.

A sword god, with the power he brought now, was not enough to fight.

Because he had really seen the strength of a sword god.

That gave him a feeling of deep despair.

Buzz——

Instantly, a three-foot-long sword cut through the sky, tore through the void, and came straight to the battlefield.

"No, block it!"

Wang Zhen was quick-witted and immediately mobilized all his divine power, and then blasted at the divine sword.

Boom!

The entire starry sky began to shatter.

The fragments of the void poured down, accompanied by a destructive aura, which shocked everyone present.

What a strong power!

At this time, Wang Zhen breathed a sigh of relief.

This sword intent has not yet reached the level of a god. Although it is not far away, a slight mistake can lead to a thousand miles.

However, although there is no sword intent that reaches the level of a god, the opponent's strength cannot be underestimated.

Because the opponent is actually a super god.

I saw a white-haired old man in a white robe slowly emerging from the depths of the starry sky.

The next moment, an illusory river of sword condensed from under his feet, accompanied by countless sword sounds, the old man stepped on the river of sword and slowly came here.

"Dare to invade my Tianlin Star Region, do you think there is no one in my Tianlin Star Region?"

An extremely cold voice sounded from his mouth.

Suddenly, the entire Tianlin Star Region was boiling.

This powerful sword cultivator of the super god realm is actually a strong man in their Tianlin Star Region.

For a moment, everyone in the Tianlin Star Region rekindled hope.

Beside Luo Ming, Yan Yan and Hun Gu Star Region and others were also stunned.

There are actually super god realm strong men in this Tianlin Star Region.

Looking at Luo Ming's surprised look, it seems that even he doesn't know.

In that case, will there be hidden super god realm strong men in their star region?

Thinking of this, they immediately had the idea of going back to find them.

In the distance, Wang Zhen clenched his fists slowly, looking at the sword cultivator with a super god-like aura.

Is this what Mr. Zhou said is not simple?

It is indeed not simple.

However, what if he is a super god-like strongman? He is a general of the Divine Dynasty.

"Come, let me see how powerful the sword cultivator of the super god-like realm is."

As soon as the voice fell, Wang Zhen rushed directly towards the sword cultivator.

Swish!

The sound of the sword rang out, and Wang Zhen immediately retreated hundreds of feet away, and a blood mark slowly emerged from his cheek.

The difference was immediately determined!

"I give you three breaths of time, get out of the Tianlin Star Region!"

The old sword cultivator looked cold and shouted.

Looking at the old sword cultivator in the distance, Wang Zhen was silent.

With just one move, he understood how strong the opponent was. Although he did not have the sword intent to communicate with the gods, the realm of the super god-like realm was not something he could cross now.

Just as he was about to order a retreat, a terrifying dragon power suddenly surged out from the void behind the army.

In just a moment, the entire starry sky began to crack.

What is that? !

Everyone looked over there.

A five-clawed dragon emitting a sacred light rushed towards them.

The dragon power emanating from its body made all the weak practitioners lie on the ground.

Super God Realm!

It turned out to be a super god ice dragon!

At this time, Wang Zhen was already stunned in the same place, and his heart was extremely horrified.

Ao Qing!

This five-clawed dragon was actually super god.

The next moment, a bitter feeling surged from his heart.

It turned out that the clown had always been himself.

The opponent's strength still needed his protection.

What's even more ridiculous is that he actually thought that Ao Qing hid because he was afraid of the swords and knives on the battlefield.

Everything was just his own random guess.

Seeing Ao Qing rushing towards him, the old sword cultivator looked fierce, "Come on!"

Buzz——

Instantly, the old man swung his long sword and slashed.

A sword beam accompanied by a destructive aura flew towards Ao Qing.

A hideous scratch appeared in the air wherever it passed, showing the horror of this attack.

Seeing this scene, Wang Zhen was shocked. This attack was even more terrifying than the one he had just used against him.

The other party actually held back.

"Be careful!"

Hearing Wang Zhen's reminder, Ao Qing sneered in his heart.

Do you think I'm scared?

It's finally my turn to show off, so I have to show off.

Then, Ao Qing ran head-on.

Resist with my body!

Boom!

The sword beam sank into Ao Qing's head, and Ao Qing was unscathed.

"What!"

"Impossible!!"

This was a full-strength attack from a super-godly strong man, but the five-clawed dragon was able to withstand it.

Is the five-clawed dragon so powerful?

At this time, Ao Qing sneered and said, "It's my turn."

"Ice the Thousand Miles!"

Ao Qing sprayed the cold air containing the terrifying law of ice towards the old sword cultivator.

In just a moment, the entire starry sky was instantly frozen.

In the Tianlin Star Region, except for Luo Ming and Han Tianren, the other cultivators almost all lost their combat effectiveness.

The law of ice was used to the extreme, which was so terrifying.

As the main target of the attack, the old sword cultivator was even more uncomfortable, and his divine power was frozen for a moment.

At this moment, he could hardly hold the sword in his hand.

Feeling the sluggishness of his body, the old sword cultivator's face changed drastically, and he quickly used his sword intent to break the power of the law in his body.

It's a pity that his sword intent was not divine after all.

In this brief moment, a terrifying dragon tail swung towards him.

Boom!

A terrifying black hole emerged from the void.

I saw a figure suddenly retreating thousands of feet away.

It was the old sword cultivator.

"Senior!"

Seeing the old sword cultivator's flesh and blood bursting, the Tianlin Star Region was immediately horrified.

They were both in the super-god realm, but could the gap be so big?

In fact, the old sword cultivator was not weak, but because he was facing Ao Qing.

What Ao Qing ate and drank in the deserted city were not ordinary things, all of them were treasures from heaven and earth, which were simply great supplements. His body was extremely terrifying. If he did not have an extremely powerful killing technique, it would be a fantasy to break Ao Qing's defense.

Although the sword of the old sword cultivator was very sharp, it was obviously not enough.

Therefore, Ao Qing was already invincible at this moment.

At this time, Ao Qing had already gone towards the old sword cultivator again.

Boom!

The old man's sword was still unable to cause any harm to Ao Qing.

The old man himself retreated violently again.

Seeing this, the people in the distant Tianlin Star Region suddenly showed despair.

This time, it was really over.

Looking at the terrifying Ao Qing, Wang Zhen put away his respectful eyes and then looked at the people in the Tianlin Star Region.

Let's talk about the apology when we get back.

Now, the most important thing is to take down the Tianlin Star Region first.
